relations.name: learn_launch_email_messages
relations.definition:
SELECT id,
    tenant_id,
    created_at,
    jsonb_build_object('label_ids', to_jsonb(ARRAY( SELECT label.label
           FROM unnest(ARRAY['INBOX'::text, 'SENT'::text, 'DRAFT'::text]) label(label)
          WHERE email_messages.raw_payload @> jsonb_build_object('label_ids', jsonb_build_array(label.label))))) AS raw_payload
   FROM email_messages;

relations.name: learn_launch_email_sync_runs
relations.definition:
SELECT tenant_id,
    status,
    sync_type,
    started_at,
    completed_at,
    records_processed,
        CASE
            WHEN error_message IS NULL THEN NULL::text
            WHEN error_message = ''::text THEN ''::text
            ELSE '[redacted]'::text
        END AS error_message
   FROM email_sync_runs;
